watches.name: EDC2-B Tactical
watches.description: Quick specs: 40mm 316L forged Stainless steel case with drilled lugs 41mm stepped bezel Heat treated and bead blast finish with anti-fingerprint coating 20mm lug width 47.9mm lug to lug 10.8mm thickness 2.4 mm thick sapphire 10ATM (100 meters) water resistance Miyota Japan 2170 Solar movement Screw down crown Threaded caseback 20mm 1pc. heavy nylon tactical strap 3-layer dial with 2-tone multi-layered X1 grade Super-Luminova Diamond-cut hands Full description: The EDC-2 range gives you a 40mm case with a fixed 41mm stepped bezel. This watch was developed using modern 3D CAD software to engineer every small detail. These are not "off the shelf" cases, crowns, dials, hands and other major external parts. This is all functional design. The 40mm 316L stainless steel case is forged from a solid block for maximum density and strength, machined out internally, heat treated and fine bead blasted for increased surface hardness. If that were not enough, we also added an anti-fingerprint coating to the surface to fill in any microscopic pits left from bead blasting that can collect grease and oils. The final surface finish is completely smooth and extremely scratch resistant. The crystal is sapphire with an anti-reflective coating on the inside to help cut down glare yet remain extremely scratch resistant on the outside. The movement is a new concept. Completely solar powered but not in a traditional way. Generally with a solar movement, the panels are under the dial, requiring the dial to have limitations and has to also be at least 60% transparent. Enter the Japan made Miyota 2170 movement used here. This movement allows for 100% freedom in dial design. The solar panels are vertical and surrounding the edge of the dial beneath the sapphire. There is a clear ring over the panel so its nearly impossible to even see it. No battery changes are required! Exposure to sunlight will provide up to 4 months of continuous use on a full charge. In daily use it will run continuously on sunlight. This movement is also designed to pull the weight of heavier, luminous hands. The dial is made in 3 layers. The base layer, a matte painted flat brass 0.40mm thick dial. Markers are printed generously with X1 grade C3 GL (green glow) Super-Luminova. The second layer is also a 0.40mm thick, matte black painted brass ring that lays over the top of the smoothly rounded luminous markers with laser cutouts to create a clean sandwich shadow effect, adding a nice extra dimension to the dial. The 3rd layer is a 0.20mm thick layer of X1 grade C3 BL (blue glow) Super-Luminova surrounding the main dial markers for that extra pop in dimension and luminous performance. The unique diamond cut hands are custom designed to flow well with the smooth curves and corners of the dial. Length is carefully calculated to match with the dial layers. As a little easter egg, the tail of the seconds hand lines up exactly inside the EDC emblem when at 12:00. The Hour and minute hands are filled with X1 grade C3 GL (green glow) Super-Luminova while the seconds hand is filled with X1 grade C3 BL (blue glow) Super-Luminova. The 7mm threaded and sealed crown is designed for easy use with smoothly formed edges to enhance comfort on the wrist. There is an embossed logo on the end. The sealing design helps this watch achieve its 100 meter water resistance. With a common 20mm lug width, this watch is designed to accept just about any 20mm strap you can throw on it. Drilled lugs allow for really easy strap changes. The lug design curves downward to wrap closer to your wrist for comfort. This version includes a comfortable heavy gauge nylon 1pc strap. With the strap passing under the watch, this adds a layer of nylon material between your wrist and the watch body making it more comfortable in cold weather. In case of impact, the 1pc strap allows the watch to stay connected to the strap if one of the springbars is damaged, preventing the watch from being knocked on to the ground. The case back is
